entities.name: Facundo Díaz Acosta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Facundo Díaz Acosta is an Argentine professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 47, achieved on 22 April 2024 and a doubles ranking of No. 173, achieved on 28 November 2022. Díaz Acosta has won one singles ATP title at the 2024 Argentina Open.
